corrections.currentAnswer: According to the applied methodology VM0042 (version 2.1), continuation of pre-project ALM practices is the most plausible baseline scenario
corrections.currentQuote: According to the applied methodology VM0042 (version 2.1), continuation of pre-project ALM practices is the most plausible baseline scenario. Following the methodology guidance, the baseline scenario is determined by producing an annual schedule of activities from the practices applied in each field/farming unit/project activity instance, from a historic look-back period (of at least three years or to include one complete crop-cycle). Baseline emissions/stock changes are then modeled (Quantification Approach 1) or (for SOC stock change only) directly measured in baseline control sites subject to the annual schedule of activities (Quantification Approach 2).
